describe: make something on the page move, flip, lift up or animate, or change the order or layout of the page
guide: Movement on hover belongs in styles.css: a :hover rule with transform (for example .card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); }) and a transition on the normal rule. Changing the order of sections is moving the whole <section>...</section> block in index.html, and the nav links with it.
You cannot see the page: say what you changed and ask them to press Preview Website.
